story.body: You voted with John. You said, because Thomas made you, that the month suits you better than it suits the hired men. You did not add a wage. Augustine did not speak. The dates went to the foot of the sheet.

relations.note: the sheet with the dates at the foot

story.body: You read the twenty-sixth, the twenty-fifth of August, and the seventeenth. You did not see a wage added under them.

title: Read the dates at the foot

participation.context: Looked, and left it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the sheet beside the jug and the bread. You did not add a line.

title: Looked at the sheet beside the jug and the bread

relations.quote: To practise on. John's glass is in the chest, and that is the one thou'lt break.

story.body: You gave the glass. You did not pay the fourteen pence, because Agnes forgave the slate. You did not enter either sum in a coffer. Augustine sang two verses and stopped. You stayed past the capon.

participation.context: Ended the song.

participation.context: Noted the hour, and cleared the way.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Asked the question, and kept the forgiveness to one night.
participation.name: Agnes Tipping

relations.quote: Where does it pain you tonight, Will?

story.body: You stood. You told Agnes the pain was in the head, and that there was a city in it. You did not take the glass back. You left.

relations.quote: Where does it pain you tonight, Will?

title: Rose at nine and said the pain was a city
